header.title: How can we help?
header.subtitle: Pick a question to see the answer right here — no typing needed.

uploadDocuments.label: Upload documents
uploadDocuments.question: How do I add my documents?
uploadDocuments.answer: Open **Knowledge Base** in the sidebar, then drag files onto the upload zone or use the file picker. You can assign a category as you upload. You can also paste a **URL** to import a web page. Files are ingested automatically and become searchable in chat.

supportedTypes.label: Supported file types
supportedTypes.question: What file types can I upload?
supportedTypes.answer: PDF, Word (`.docx`), PowerPoint (`.pptx`), Markdown (`.md`), plain text (`.txt`), CSV, and images (PNG/JPG). Scanned or image-only PDFs are **OCR'd** automatically so their text becomes searchable.

attachFiles.label: Attach files to a message
attachFiles.question: Can I attach files or images to a single message?
attachFiles.answer: Yes. Click the **paperclip** in the message box (or drag onto it) to attach documents or images to one question. They're analysed just for that message — afterwards you can choose **Add to Knowledge Base** to keep them permanently.

voiceInput.label: Voice input
voiceInput.question: How do I ask with my voice?
voiceInput.answer: Tap the **microphone** in the message box and speak. Your speech is transcribed **locally** and dropped into the input, so you can review and edit it before sending.

focusDocuments.label: Focus on specific documents
focusDocuments.question: How do I limit answers to certain documents?
focusDocuments.answer: Use the **scope filter** above the message box to restrict answers to a category or specific files. The active scope is stamped on your message as a badge, and it clears after sending so your next message uses everything again.

seeSources.label: See the sources
seeSources.question: How do I check where an answer came from?
seeSources.answer: Every answer lists its **sources** in the right-hand panel. Expand any entry to see the exact text chunk the AI used, its relevance score, and a link to open the original file.

categories.label: Organise with categories
categories.question: How do I organise my documents?
categories.answer: When uploading, give a document a **category** (e.g. *Contracts*, *Research*, *Recipes*). Categories show up as folders in the scope filter, so you can focus a chat — or any generated material — on one topic area.

quizzes.label: Quizzes
quizzes.question: How do I generate a quiz?
quizzes.answer: Go to **Study Hub → Quiz Mode**, scope it to your documents, choose difficulty, the number of questions, and **Practice** (instant feedback) or **Exam** (deferred) mode, then start. Every quiz is saved so you can resume or retake it.

workshops.label: Workshops
workshops.question: How do I build a multi-lesson workshop?
workshops.answer: **Study Hub → Workshop Creator** builds a structured, multi-lesson course from your scoped documents — an outline plus lessons you work through one at a time, finishing with a final quiz.

flashcards.label: Flashcards
flashcards.question: How do flashcards work?
flashcards.answer: **Study Hub → Flashcards** generates a deck from your documents. Flip each card, mark it **Mastered** or **For review**, and your progress is saved per deck.

mindmaps.label: Mindmaps
mindmaps.question: How do I create and export a mindmap?
mindmaps.answer: **Study Hub → Mindmaps** turns your documents into an interactive node map. **Drag nodes** to rearrange, switch **Left-right / Top-down** layout, and export as **Markdown, PNG, or PDF**.

dashboard.label: Activity dashboard
dashboard.question: Where do I see my activity and time?
dashboard.answer: The **Dashboard** shows your total time, sessions, current and best streak, a per-area breakdown, and a daily activity **heatmap**. Click any day in the heatmap for that day's details.

achievements.label: Achievements
achievements.question: What achievements can I unlock?
achievements.answer: Badges unlock automatically as you use the app — first question, daily streaks, quizzes, decks, mindmaps, and more. Find them in the Dashboard's **Achievements** grid; click a badge to see your progress toward it.

exporting.label: Exporting
exporting.question: How do I export my work?
exporting.answer: Quizzes export to **Markdown** or **PDF**; mindmaps export to **Markdown, PNG, or PDF** (buttons on each screen). Individual chat answers can be exported to Markdown too.

privacy.label: Privacy & storage
privacy.question: Where is my data stored?
privacy.answer: **Everything stays on your machine.** Your documents, the search index, chat history, and progress are all local files. Nothing is sent to any third-party AI service — the model runs locally.
